## Summary

1. **Investigated current state**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was **unhealthy** with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so the deploy required change-manager approval per policy.

2. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** to all production regions. Change-manager approval was granted ("Approved. Looks right."), and the rollout completed successfully.

3. **Verified health post-deploy**: checkout-api is now healthy in all three regions with the error rate down to **0.2%** (from 18%).

4. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 baseline, the hotfix deployment, the change-manager approval, and the successful post-deploy verification. The on-call engineer has been paged.
